spawns.notes: Prima SI lists Spindle at L50, and the Dec 2002 Allakhazam entry (cmob 5022) has it as Monster L50 in the Dales. The period quest log is the only position source: exactly 2 of them under the 2nd floor of Meical's workshop. Behaviour from the log: it casts a sticky-web root/entangle at players and cannot be killed. The server should make it non-killable (immortal, untargetable or peace-flagged, a trap that casts a root spell) and not leave it as a normal killable L50 mob. The root spell itself is not recorded; use an existing root line. Stats, brain and faction come from 'heavy metal' 99993502 (Chaotic Constructs faction 7, inside the same building). Respawn is a default; no period number exists. Coordinates are region 51 world units.
spawns.position_source: Allakhazam quest 686 'Restoring the Magic' walkthrough (patch 1.60, comments dated Feb–Jul 2003). It reads 'Spindle - 2 of these under the 2nd floor of the house. Cannot kill them.' and logs 'You are entangled in a sticky web!' inside the house. A Mar 2003 comment mentions 'those silly things at the entrance constantly rooting'. Evidence: it is in the Prima Gwyddneau level table but on no map label. It has zero radar, Uthgard or forum sightings by name. Prima SI says four sisters hold Colialt at Sanctuary Rock near the holly grove. Period posts (Freddyshouse 2003) say the event runs at night at the undead-slayer camp west of Clifton: 'undead things came out of the floor' and attack the Undead Slayers, in 4-5 waves (first two red-purple at 50, the rest purple), then the level-70 demoliches, then Colialt (78). The levels fit the waves: angered corpse 56-57, Undeath Walking 59, Intimidator 61, Dissolver 60-62, Carnage Ghoul 63, Demolich 70. Colialt.cs exists in the scripts, but Colialt has no Mob row, and its adds are hardcoded 'ancient zombie' models. A static spawn at the slayer camp would constantly fight Lacula Sept (Undead Servants are aggressive toward them). Recommend spawning it from a Colialt event script at the site above.

Period evidence says this is a quest pop, not a static spawn. (1) A Freddyshouse thread from 2003-07-27 is titled 'Cabalist lvl 30 epic - broken?'. Lorthania writes that he killed the Arawnite Assassin in Snowdonia Fortress, his log did not update, and 'he will not pop anymore'. (2) The quest spec (quests/specs/albion.jsonl) has the kill step 'Search the Snowdonia border keep for the assassin and slay him', with loc_note 'southwest landing of the Snowdonia border keep; appears for the quest holder' and spawn lv31. dialogue.json has the assassin's period speech. (3) Prima Atlas lists it as 'Arawnite Assassin [28] (no loot)' (no loot fits a quest mob). Illia lists 30-30 Humanoid Thrust.
